Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (CXMS) study to identify interaction sites between Gd-IgA1 and TfR1. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'No PTMs are included', the methods describe a cross-linking strategy using EDC/sulfo-NHS and glutaraldehyde, which is a form of complexome/interaction proteomics. No stable isotope labeling is mentioned; relative quantification is listed in PRIDE metadata.
